attributes.name: Raytheon Company
attributes.blurb: Defense contractor; merged with UTC. Surviving company exists as a subsidiary of the renamed UTC, company, Raytheon Technologies
attributes.summary:
Raytheon is a major American defense contractor that specializes in defense and homeland security technology. As the world’s largest producer of guided missiles, Raytheon specializes in manufacturing defense systems and defense electronics. 

A member of the defense electronic industry, Raytheon is most active lobbying on defense, homeland security and federal budget appropriation issues.

attributes.name: Covidien plc.
attributes.blurb: Irish-headquartered global health care products company and manufacturer of medical devices and supplies
attributes.summary: In June 2014, Covidien agreed to be acquired by Medtronic for $42.9 billion.
